words.ex_cn: 牛奶含有大量的钙。
words.en: A chemical element that is present in teeth and bones and is necessary for their health.

words.ex: The businessman sold his products to many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这位商人把他的产品卖到了许多国家。
words.en: A businessman is a man who works in business, especially at a high level.

words.ex: He seeks help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: If you seek something, you try to find it or obtain it.

words.ex: The school prohibits students from using phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If a law or someone in authority prohibits something, they forbid it or make it illegal.

words.ex: The bridge is stable and safe to cross.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥很稳固，可以安全通过。
words.en: If something is stable, it is not likely to change or come to an end suddenly.

words.tr:
v. 使困惑；难倒；阻碍
n. 挡板；遮护物；阻碍体
words.ex: The magic trick baffled the children.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让孩子们感到困惑。
words.en: If something baffles you, you cannot understand it or explain it.

words.ex: The concert was fabulous!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太棒了！
words.en: If you describe something as fabulous, you are emphasizing that you like it a lot or think that it is very good.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.ex: Water is indispensable for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必不可少的。
words.en: Absolutely necessary or essential.

words.ex: The small town has a maritime history.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有着海洋历史。
words.en: Relating to the sea, especially in relation to seaborne trade or naval matters.

words.ex: He packed his luggage before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行前收拾好了行李。
words.en: Luggage consists of the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel.

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.ex: The child screamed when she saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当那个孩子看到狗时，她尖叫了起来。
words.en: If you scream, you shout or cry in a loud high-pitched voice, usually because you are in pain or are very frightened.

words.tr:
n. 编年史；年代记
v. 按时间顺序记录
words.ex: He writes a chronicle of his daily life.
words.ex_cn: 他记录自己每天的生活。
words.en: A chronicle is a historical account of events arranged in chronological order, typically without analysis or interpretation.

words.ex: The factory will automate the assembly line.
words.ex_cn: 工厂将自动化装配线。
words.en: To automate a factory, office, or industrial process means to put in machines which can do the work instead of people.

words.tr:
prep. 遍及；各处；自始至终；
adv. 自始至终；到处；
words.ex: She traveled throughout the country.
words.ex_cn: 她遍及全国旅行。
words.en: In every part of a place or thing; during the whole of a period of time.

words.ex: The cake has three layers of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力。
words.en: A layer of a substance or material is a quantity or piece of it that covers a surface or that is between two other things.

words.ex: The cake has a sweet flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有一种甜味。
words.en: The flavor of a food or drink is its taste, especially a pleasant or distinctive one.

words.ex: He is obese because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多垃圾食品而肥胖。
words.en: If someone is obese, they are extremely fat.

words.ex: Many people lost jobs during the recession.
words.ex_cn: 在经济不景气期间，许多人失去了工作。
words.en: A recession is a period when the economy of a country is not doing well, industrial production and business activity are at a low level, and many people are unemployed.

words.ex: He gave an absolute yes to the offer.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个提议给出了完全肯定的回答。
words.en: Absolute means complete and total, or not limited in any way.

words.ex: France was an ally of the United States in the war.
words.ex_cn: 法国在战争中是美国的同盟者。
words.en: An ally is a country, organization, or person that helps and supports another country, organization, or person in a difficult situation.

words.ex: They drank champagne at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他们在婚礼上喝了香槟。
words.en: Champagne is an expensive French white wine with bubbles in. It is often drunk to celebrate something.

words.ex: She transcended her fears to speak on stage.
words.ex_cn: 她超越了自己的恐惧，在舞台上发言。
words.en: If something transcends normal limits or boundaries, it goes beyond them, because it is more significant than them.

words.ex: Nike is a famous brand.
words.ex_cn: 耐克是一个著名品牌。
words.en: A brand is a name, term, design, symbol, or any other feature that identifies one seller's good or service as distinct from those of other sellers.

words.tr: v. 激怒；使急躁；使疼痛
words.ex: Loud noises irritate my baby.
words.ex_cn: 噪音会激怒我的宝宝。
words.en: If something irritates you, it keeps annoying you.

words.ex: He wrote his name on a sheet of paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在一张纸上写了名字。
words.en: A sheet is a large piece of thin cloth used on a bed to lie on or under. It can also refer to a flat, thin piece of material, such as paper, metal, or glass.

words.ex: They wrote a love letter every day, and it became their romance.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天写一封情书，这成为了他们的浪漫史。
words.en: Romance refers to the feelings and behaviors characteristic of love, especially in its early stages, or a story, movie, or other work dealing with love in a sentimental or idealized way.

words.ex: Children tend to be more active in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子往往在早上更活跃。
words.en: If someone tends to do something, they usually do it or they often do it.

words.ex: He lingered by the door, not wanting to leave.
words.ex_cn: 他逗留在门口，不想离开。
words.en: If you linger somewhere, you stay there for a longer time than is necessary, for example because you are enjoying yourself.

words.ex: They celebrated their wedding anniversary with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们用晚餐庆祝结婚纪念日。
words.en: An anniversary is a date which is remembered or celebrated because a special event happened on that date in a previous year.

words.ex: He sat on the chair and read a book.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在椅子上读书。
words.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

words.ex: I take the subway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天坐地铁去上班。
words.en: An underground railway system in a city, usually operated by electricity, which provides a rapid means of transportation.

words.tr:
v. 抗议；
n. 抗议活动；
words.ex: The students protest against the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 学生们抗议新的校规。
words.en: A protest is the act of saying or showing publicly that you object to something.

words.tr:
v. 移栽；移植；
n. 移植；
words.ex: He will transplant the flowers to the garden tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要把这些花移栽到花园里。
words.en: To transplant something means to move it from one place to another. In medicine, to transplant an organ, piece of skin, etc. means to use it to replace a damaged part in someone's body.

words.ex: The universe may be infinite.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙可能是无限的。
words.en: If you describe something as infinite, you are emphasizing that it is extremely great in amount or degree.

words.ex: He used a stick to lever the heavy rock.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子撬动那块大石头。
words.en: A lever is a handle that you pull or push to operate a machine. It can also refer to a rigid bar pivoted about a fulcrum, used to transfer a force to a load and usually to provide a mechanical advantage.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.ex: He took his words in a literal sense.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的话按字面意思理解。
words.en: If you describe something as the literal truth or a literal fact, you are emphasizing that it is true.

words.ex: She bought a new outfit for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一套新衣服。
words.en: An outfit is a set of clothes worn together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose.

words.ex: He bought a leather jacket for winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天买了一件皮夹克。
words.en: Leather is a material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.

words.ex: She combines flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To combine means to join or merge two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.tr: adj. 值得注意的；显著的；
words.ex: This result is noteworthy because it changes our understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个结果值得注意，因为它改变了我们的理解。
words.en: If you describe something as noteworthy, you mean that it is interesting, significant, or important enough to deserve attention or to be noticed.

words.ex: He refused to disclose the secret.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝透露这个秘密。
words.en: To disclose information means to make it known to the public.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.ex: He wore a funny costume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对穿了一套滑稽的服装。
words.en: A costume is a set of clothes in a style typical of a particular country or historical period, or a set of clothes worn by an actor for a particular role.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: The company used a new formula to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用了一个新方案来解决问题。
words.en: A formula is a plan or method that is used to achieve a particular goal, especially in science or mathematics.

words.ex: Children are vulnerable to colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 儿童在冬天容易感冒。
words.en: If someone or something is vulnerable, they are weak and without protection, with the result that they are easily hurt physically or emotionally.

words.tr:
v. 提升；提高；改进；
n. 增加；改进；
words.ex: He upgraded his phone to get better performance.
words.ex_cn: 他升级了手机以获得更好的性能。
words.en: To upgrade means to improve the quality or usefulness of something, or to raise it to a higher standard. It can also refer to the process of improving or raising something.

words.ex: The number of apples corresponds to the number of oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的数量与橙子的数量相对应。
words.en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one is the cause or the result of the other.

words.ex: The ball is a perfect sphere.
words.ex_cn: 这个球是一个完美的球体。
words.en: A sphere is a perfectly round three-dimensional shape, like a ball. It can also refer to a particular area of interest, activity, or knowledge.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.ex: He gave the rope a sudden jerk to pull it up.
words.ex_cn: 他猛地一拉绳子，把它拉了上来。
words.en: If you jerk something or someone in a particular direction, or they jerk in a particular direction, they move a short distance very suddenly and quickly.

words.ex: He gropped in the dark for the light switch.
words.ex_cn: 他在黑暗中摸索着找电灯开关。
words.en: If you grope for something that you cannot see, you try to find it by moving your hands around in order to feel it.

words.ex: The heavy workload became a burden for her.
words.ex_cn: 繁重的工作量成了她的负担。
words.en: A burden is a heavy load that is difficult to carry, or a duty or responsibility that is hard to bear.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.tr: n. [英]地铁；管子；管状物；电视机；
words.ex: I take the tube to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A tube is a long, hollow cylinder used for conveying or holding liquids or gases.

words.ex: He tried to evade the police by driving fast.
words.ex_cn: 他试图通过高速驾驶来逃避警察。
words.en: If you evade something, you find a way of not doing something that you really ought to do.

words.ex: He opted to stay home instead of going out.
words.ex_cn: 他选择待在家里而不是出去。
words.en: If you opt for something, or opt to do something, you choose it or decide to do it in preference to anything else.

words.ex: He drives on the motorway every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在高速公路上开车。
words.en: A motorway is a wide road specially built for fast travel over long distances, with a limited number of places at which drivers can enter and leave it.

words.ex: This book is about the realm of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于人工智能领域的。
words.en: A realm is a country ruled by a king or queen, or an area of activity, interest, or knowledge.

words.ex: He learned about sex in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学到了性。
words.en: Sex refers to the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences rather than biological ones.

words.ex: The factory has a quota of 1000 units per day.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每天有1000件的配额。
words.en: A quota is the limited number or quantity of something which is officially allowed.

words.tr:
v. 交叠；使部分重叠；
n. 重叠部分；
words.ex: The two colors overlap on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 两种颜色在墙上交叠。
words.en: If one thing overlaps another, or if you overlap them, a part of the first thing occupies the same area as a part of the other thing. You can also say that two things overlap.

words.ex: Farmers grow tomatoes in a greenhouse.
words.ex_cn: 农民在温室里种植番茄。
words.en: A greenhouse is a building with glass walls and roof; for the cultivation and exhibition of plants under controlled conditions.

words.ex: He felt the stigma of being unemployed.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到了失业的耻辱。
words.en: A stigma is a strong feeling of disapproval that most people in a society have about something, especially when this is unfair.

words.ex: The nerve in his finger was damaged.
words.ex_cn: 他手指里的神经受到了损伤。
words.en: A nerve is a bundle of fibers that transmits impulses of sensation to the brain or spinal cord, and impulses from these to the muscles and organs. It also refers to the courage or control needed to do something difficult or dangerous.

words.ex: The rain ceased after an hour.
words.ex_cn: 一小时后，雨停了。
words.en: If something ceases, it stops happening or existing.

words.ex: The priest said a prayer for the sick.
words.ex_cn: 牧师为病人祈祷。
words.en: A priest is a person who is qualified to perform religious duties and ceremonies in a Christian church.

words.ex: The elite of the city often meet at private clubs.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的精英经常在私人俱乐部会面。
words.en: You can refer to the most powerful, rich, or talented people within a particular group, place, or society as the elite.

words.ex: The flaw in the glass made it break easily.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃上的瑕疵让它很容易碎。
words.en: A flaw is a mistake or weakness in something that makes it less effective or valuable.

words.ex: He found a weapon in the old box.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧箱子里发现了一件武器。
words.en: A weapon is an object that can be used to harm or kill someone, or to damage or destroy something.

words.tr:
adj. 牛奶的；乳品的；
n. 乳品店；
words.ex: She bought dairy products from the local farm.
words.ex_cn: 她从当地农场买了乳制品。
words.en: A dairy is a place where milk and cream are kept or where butter and cheese are made.

words.ex: The ship carries a large cargo of rice.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船运载了大量大米货物。
words.en: Cargo refers to the goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other large vehicle.

words.ex: This plant produces electricity using nuclear power.
words.ex_cn: 这座电厂使用核能发电。
words.en: relating to the nucleus of an atom, or to the energy produced when the nucleus of an atom is split or joined with another nucleus

words.ex: The lid is tight on the jar.
words.ex_cn: 罐子的盖子很紧。
words.en: Something that is tight is fastened or fixed firmly and is not loose.

words.ex: He loves reading literary books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读文学书籍。
words.en: Literary means concerned with or connected with the writing, study, or appreciation of literature.

words.tr:
n. 钩；挂钩；
v. 钩住；
words.ex: The key hung on a metal hook.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙挂在金属钩上。
words.en: A hook is a bent piece of metal or plastic that is used for catching or holding things, or for hanging things on.

words.ex: His motive was to help his family.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助家人。
words.en: Your motive for doing something is your reason for doing it.

words.ex: Wheat is a basic commodity in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 小麦在许多国家是一种基本商品。
words.en: A commodity is something that is bought and sold.

words.ex: The workers used a hoist to lift the heavy beams.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用吊升机械吊起沉重的梁。
words.en: To hoist something means to lift or pull it up to a higher position, usually using some kind of equipment such as a crane or pulley.

words.tr:
n. 小块；碎片；废金属；吵架
v. 废弃；取消
adj. 废弃的
words.ex: He picked up a scrap of paper from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起一张纸片。
words.en: A scrap is a small piece or amount of something, especially one that is left over after the greater part has been used. It can also mean to discard or get rid of something as being no longer useful or necessary.

words.tr:
n. 踪迹；轨道；小路；跑道；
v. 追踪；跟踪；
words.ex: The dog followed the track of the rabbit.
words.ex_cn: 狗跟着兔子的踪迹。
words.en: A track is a path or route along which something moves or travels. It can also refer to marks left by something that has passed, or the act of following such marks to find someone or something.

words.ex: He buys poultry at the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他在当地市场买家禽。
words.en: Poultry refers to domesticated birds kept by humans for their eggs, meat, or feathers.

words.ex: Prior to the meeting, we reviewed the report.
words.ex_cn: 在会议之前，我们复习了报告。
words.en: Existing or coming before in time, order, or importance.

words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.ex: His mission is to help poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他的使命是帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: A mission is an important task that people are given to do, especially one that involves travelling to another country.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: The rain precedes the storm.
words.ex_cn: 雨先于风暴来临。
words.en: If one event or period of time precedes another, it happens before it.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: He uses an app to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个应用程序来学习英语。
words.en: An app is a computer program that is designed for a specific purpose, especially one that can be downloaded onto a mobile device.

words.tr:
n. 跳跃；
v. 跳跃；
words.ex: The cat made a big leap over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳过了篱笆。
words.en: To leap means to jump high or a long way, or to move quickly and with a lot of energy.

words.ex: The upper shelf is too high to reach.
words.ex_cn: 上面的架子太高了，够不着。
words.en: Higher in place or position; situated above another part.

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.ex: He will mend his broken shoe.
words.ex_cn: 他将修补他破掉的鞋子。
words.en: If you mend something that is broken or damaged, you repair it, so that it works properly or so that it looks like new again.

words.tr:
n. 格式；
v. 格式化；
words.ex: The file is in PDF format.
words.ex_cn: 这个文件是PDF格式。
words.en: The way in which something is arranged or set out.

words.tr:
n. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
v. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
words.ex: The flight had a delay because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 由于风暴，航班推迟了。
words.en: If you delay doing something, you do not do it immediately or at the planned or expected time, but you leave it until later.

words.ex: It's an irony that the fire station burned down.
words.ex_cn: 消防站着火了，这真是讽刺。
words.en: Irony is a subtle form of humor which involves saying things that you do not mean.

words.ex: He tried acupuncture to relieve his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他尝试针刺疗法来缓解背痛。
words.en: Acupuncture is a form of treatment that involves inserting very thin needles through a person's skin at specific points on the body, to various depths, for therapeutic purposes.

words.tr: n. 有价值的人或物；长处；
words.ex: He is an asset to the team because he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有价值的人，因为他工作努力。
words.en: An asset is something valuable that an individual, corporation, or country owns or controls with the expectation that it will provide a future benefit.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.ex: He filed a lawsuit against the company.
words.ex_cn: 他向这家公司提起了诉讼。
words.en: A lawsuit is a case in a court of law which concerns a dispute between two people or organizations.

words.ex: He speculates that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他推测明天会下雨。
words.en: If you speculate about something, you make guesses about its nature or identity, or about what might happen.

words.ex: The car drove slowly through the fog.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓缓驶过浓雾。
words.en: Fog is a thick cloud of tiny water droplets suspended in the atmosphere at or near the earth's surface which obscures or restricts visibility (to a greater extent than mist; strictly, reducing visibility to below 1 km).

words.ex: He was late, so he left accordingly.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，于是相应地提前出发了。
words.en: In a way that is appropriate to the particular circumstances.

words.tr:
n. 输出；出口；
v. 输出；出口；
words.ex: This country is a big export of wheat.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家是小麦的大输出国。
words.en: To send goods to another country for sale.

words.ex: She coordinates the team's schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她协调团队的安排。
words.en: If you coordinate an activity, you organize the various people and things involved in it. If you coordinate the different parts of your body, you make them work together efficiently.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.ex: The ceiling is white and low.
words.ex_cn: 天花板是白色的，而且很低。
words.en: The ceiling is the upper interior surface of a room or other similar compartment.

words.ex: He faced many hardships during the war.
words.ex_cn: 他在战争期间经历了许多困苦。
words.en: Hardship refers to a situation that is difficult to endure because of lack of money, resources, or other basic necessities.

words.tr:
n. 回声；
v. 回响；
words.ex: The echo came back from the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 回声从山上反弹回来。
words.en: An echo is a sound which is caused by a noise being reflected off a surface such as a wall.

words.ex: The dolphin jumped high out of the water.
words.ex_cn: 海豚从水中高高跳起。
words.en: A dolphin is a marine mammal that is known for its intelligence and friendly nature towards humans.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

words.ex: The government made a fiscal decision to lower taxes.
words.ex_cn: 政府做出了降低税收的财政决定。
words.en: Fiscal is used to describe something that relates to government money or public money, especially taxes.

words.ex: The police investigated the assault on the old man.
words.ex_cn: 警方调查了对那位老人的攻击。
words.en: An assault is a physical attack on someone, or a military attack on a place.

words.tr: n. 宽松的女短衫；女衬衫
words.ex: She wears a white blouse to work.
words.ex_cn: 她上班穿一件白色上衣。
words.en: A blouse is a piece of clothing for women, which covers their body from the neck to the waist or slightly below, and which usually has long sleeves and buttons down the front.

words.ex: A butterfly is flying over the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝴蝶在花上飞舞。
words.en: A butterfly is an insect with large, often brightly coloured wings.

words.ex: He watches the Olympic games every four years.
words.ex_cn: 他每四年观看奥运会。
words.en: Relating to the Olympic Games, an international sporting event held every four years.

words.ex: The police found a clue at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了一条线索。
words.en: A clue is an object or piece of information that helps to solve a problem or mystery.

words.ex: The baby suck milk from the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿从奶瓶里吮吸牛奶。
words.en: To draw something into the mouth by creating a partial vacuum with the lips and tongue; to be very bad or unpleasant.

words.ex: He resolved the problem with a simple plan.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个简单的计划解决了问题。
words.en: If you resolve to do something, you make a firm decision to do it.

words.ex: The university conferred an honorary degree on him.
words.ex_cn: 大学授予他一个荣誉学位。
words.en: To confer something such as a degree or an honor on someone means to give it to them in a formal way. To confer with someone means to discuss something with them in order to make a decision.

words.ex: He could discern a small bird in the trees.
words.ex_cn: 他能辨明树上有一只小鸟。
words.en: If you can discern something, you are aware of it and know what it is.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.ex: The clock struck midnight.
words.ex_cn: 钟敲响了午夜。
words.en: Midnight is twelve o'clock in the middle of the night.

words.ex: The glow of the fire warmed the room.
words.ex_cn: 火的炽热温暖了房间。
words.en: If something glows, it produces a dull, steady light.

words.tr: n. 中风；划水动作；一击；
words.ex: He had a stroke last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年中风了。
words.en: A stroke is a medical condition in which poor blood flow to the brain results in cell death. It can also refer to an act of hitting or striking someone or something, or a gentle movement of the hand over a surface.

words.ex: He felt a strong thirst after running.
words.ex_cn: 跑步后他感到强烈的口渴。
words.en: A strong desire to drink something, especially water.

words.tr:
v. 定罪；宣判有罪
n. 罪犯；囚犯
words.ex: The court convicted him of theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院判定他犯有盗窃罪。
words.en: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a court of law.

words.tr: adj. 传染性的；有感染力的；
words.ex: The flu is contagious and spreads easily.
words.ex_cn: 流感具有传染性，容易传播。
words.en: A contagious disease can be caught by touching someone who has the disease or by touching an infected object or by breathing in infected air.

words.ex: The play ended in a tragedy when the hero died.
words.ex_cn: 当英雄去世时，这部戏剧以悲剧收场。
words.en: A tragedy is an extremely sad event or situation.

words.tr: n. 掠夺者；捕食性动物；食肉动物；
words.ex: The lion is a predator that hunts deer.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种捕食鹿的掠夺者。
words.en: A predator is an animal that naturally preys on others.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.ex: He improved his vocabulary by reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天阅读来提高自己的词汇量。
words.en: The vocabulary of a person is all the words that they know or use in a particular language.

words.ex: The police used surveillance to watch the building.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用监视来观察那栋大楼。
words.en: The careful watching of a person or place, especially by the police or army, because of a crime that has happened or is expected.

words.tr:
v. 意思是说；表示…的意思；
n. 手段；方法；收入；
words.ex: This sign means you cannot park here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志意思是说这里不能停车。
words.en: Means refers to a method or way of doing something, or the resources or assets available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The glare of the sun made it hard to see.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的刺眼使我看不清。
words.en: If you glare at someone, you look at them with an angry expression on your face. Glare is also a very bright light that is uncomfortable to look at.

words.tr:
n. 雄鹿；公羊；雄兔；美元
v. （马等）猛然弓背跃起；抵制
words.ex: The buck ran through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 雄鹿在森林中奔跑。
words.en: A buck is a male deer, antelope, rabbit, or hare. It can also refer to a dollar in American slang. As a verb, it means to jump or to resist something.

words.ex: My throat is sore after singing.
words.ex_cn: 我唱歌后喉咙疼。
words.en: If part of your body is sore, it causes you pain and discomfort.

words.ex: The rain persisted all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨持续了一整天。
words.en: If you persist in doing something, you continue to do it even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.tr: adj. 高的；崇高的；傲慢的
words.ex: The mountain has a lofty peak.
words.ex_cn: 这座山有一个很高的山顶。
words.en: If you say that someone behaves in a lofty way, you are critical of them for behaving in a proud and rather unpleasant way, as if they think they are very important.

words.ex: The outer door is locked, but the inner one is open.
words.ex_cn: 外门锁着，但内门是开着的。
words.en: Outer is used to describe something that is on the outside of something else.

words.ex: He took a deep breath before jumping.
words.ex_cn: 他跳之前深吸了一口气。
words.en: The air taken into the lungs and then expelled.

words.ex: The boat floats on the water.
words.ex_cn: 船在水面上浮动。
words.en: To float means to stay on the surface of a liquid and not sink, or to move slowly in the air or on water.

words.tr:
v. 航行；驾（船）；
n. 帆；航行；航海；
words.ex: They sail to the island every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年夏天都乘船航行到那个岛。
words.en: To sail means to travel on water in a ship or boat, especially one that uses sails to catch the wind.

words.ex: He invests money in stocks.
words.ex_cn: 他投资股票。
words.en: If you invest in something, or if you invest a sum of money, you use your money in a way that you hope will increase its value, for example by putting it in a bank, or buying shares or property.

words.ex: He buys gasoline for his car every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周为他的汽车买汽油。
words.en: Gasoline is a volatile, flammable liquid obtained from petroleum and used as fuel in internal combustion engines.

words.ex: He studies architecture at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习建筑学。
words.en: Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and other physical structures.

words.tr:
adj. 一般的；普遍的；总的；大致的；首席的；
n. 将军；
words.ex: He gave a general answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个一般的回答。
words.en: A general is a high-ranking officer in the army or air force. In other contexts, general refers to something that is common, usual, or not specific.

words.ex: He felt guilt for his sin of lying.
words.ex_cn: 他因撒谎的罪行感到内疚。
words.en: Sin is an action or behaviour that is considered to be morally wrong according to religious or social laws.

words.tr:
n. 残疾；障碍；阻碍；不利
v. 妨碍；使不利
words.ex: He has a physical handicap but still runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 他有身体残疾，但仍然每天跑步。
words.en: A handicap is a condition that markedly restricts a person's ability to function physically, mentally, or socially.

words.tr:
n. 目标；目的；
v. 瞄准；以其为目标；
words.ex: His aim is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: An aim is a goal or purpose that you are trying to achieve. It can also refer to the act of directing a weapon or other object towards a target.

words.tr:
v. 振翼；颤动；飘动；挥动
n. 鼓翼；飘扬；激动不安
words.ex: The flag is fluttering in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 旗帜在风中飘扬。
words.en: If something thin or light flutters, or if you flutter it, it moves up and down or from side to side with a lot of quick, light movements.

words.tr:
n. 杂草；野草；
v. 除草；铲除；
words.ex: The garden is full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: A weed is a wild plant that grows in gardens or fields of crops and is not wanted because it harms the plants that are being grown.

words.tr: n. 专家咨询组；嵌板；仪器板；
words.ex: The government formed a panel to advise on health policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府组建了一个专家咨询组来就卫生政策提供建议。
words.en: A panel is a small group of people who are chosen to do something, for example to discuss something in public or to make a decision.

words.ex: The faint light from the candle barely lit the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛微弱的光几乎照不亮房间。
words.en: If you feel faint, you feel weak and as if you are about to lose consciousness. Something that is faint is not strong or clear.

words.ex: He devised a new way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他设计了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: To devise something means to plan or invent a new way of doing something.

words.ex: He bought an extravagant car that cost too much money.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆奢侈的车，价格太贵了。
words.en: Spending much more than is necessary or wise; excessively expensive.

words.tr:
n. 救援；营救；
v. 救援；营救；
words.ex: The rescue came just in time to save the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 救援及时赶到，救出了徒步者。
words.en: To rescue someone or something means to save them from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

words.tr:
adj. 女性的；雌性的；
n. 雌性；女性；
words.ex: The female teacher is very kind.
words.ex_cn: 这位女老师非常和蔼。
words.en: A female is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs.

words.ex: The bird ate a worm.
words.ex_cn: 鸟吃了一条蚯蚓。
words.en: A worm is a small, long, thin creature with no bones or legs that lives in soil.

words.ex: Graduating from high school was a big milestone for him.
words.ex_cn: 从高中毕业对他来说是一个重要的事件。
words.en: A milestone is a significant event or stage in the development of something.

words.tr:
n. 谣言
v. 谣传
words.ex: The rumor spread quickly that the school would close.
words.ex_cn: 学校即将关闭的谣言迅速传播开来。
words.en: A rumor is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.

words.ex: He begs for food on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他在街上乞讨食物。
words.en: If you beg someone to do something, you ask them very anxiously or eagerly to do it.

words.ex: He wore a formal suit to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套正式的西装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is formal is done or said according to an established or conventional way, especially in an official or serious situation.

words.ex: He drinks a cold beverage after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝一杯冷饮。
words.en: A drink, especially one other than water; a liquid for drinking.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.ex: He was absent from school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天缺席了学校。
words.en: If someone or something is absent from a place or situation where they should be or where they usually are, they are not there.

words.tr:
n. 快照；
v. 突然断裂；猛然咬；
adj. 突然的；匆忙的；
words.ex: He took a snap of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的快照。
words.en: If something snaps or if you snap it, it breaks suddenly, usually with a sharp cracking noise. | A snap is a photograph. | If someone snaps, or if something snaps inside them, they suddenly stop being calm and become very angry.

words.ex: He dedicates his time to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他致力于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: If you dedicate yourself to something, you give all your attention and effort to it.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet can prevent head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以防止头部受伤。
words.en: To prevent something means to stop it from happening or to stop someone from doing something.

words.ex: The two teams clashed during the match.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍在比赛中发生了冲突。
words.en: A clash is a loud, harsh noise, like the clash of cymbals. It can also refer to a conflict or disagreement.

words.tr: v. 起绰号；把…称作；配音；译制
words.ex: They dubbed him 'Captain Cool' for his calm style.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他冷静的风格给他起了个绰号叫‘冷静队长’。
words.en: To give a name, title, or nickname to someone or something; to provide a film or television program with a soundtrack in a different language from the original.

words.tr: adj. 缺乏的；不足的；稀有的；
words.ex: Water is scarce in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠里水很缺乏。
words.en: If something is scarce, there is not enough of it.

words.tr:
v. 派遣；调遣；发送
n. 快信；发送；派遣
words.ex: He will dispatch the package tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会寄出这个包裹。
words.en: To send someone or something to a particular place for a particular purpose.

words.ex: His opinion coincides with mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的一致。
words.en: If one event coincides with another, they happen at the same time.

words.ex: The teacher will announce the results tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天将宣布结果。
words.en: To announce something means to make it known publicly or officially.

words.ex: He grinds the coffee beans into powder.
words.ex_cn: 他把咖啡豆碾成粉末。
words.en: To reduce something to small particles or powder by crushing it.

words.tr:
n. 报复；报仇
v. 报复
words.ex: He wanted revenge for his brother's death.
words.ex_cn: 他想为他兄弟的死报仇。
words.en: Revenge involves hurting or punishing someone who has hurt or harmed you.

words.ex: He has diabetes and must check his blood every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有糖尿病，必须每天检查血糖。
words.en: A medical condition in which the body cannot produce enough insulin or cannot use insulin properly, leading to high levels of sugar in the blood.

words.ex: His knowledge of history is superficial.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史的了解是表面的。
words.en: If you describe someone as superficial, you disapprove of them because they do not think deeply, and have little understanding of anything serious or important.

words.ex: He preaches kindness every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都宣扬仁爱。
words.en: If you preach, you give a talk on a religious or moral subject during a religious service.

words.ex: The horror of the dark made her scream.
words.ex_cn: 对黑暗的恐惧让她尖叫。
words.en: A feeling of great fear, shock, or disgust.

words.ex: People gather in the square for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 人们在广场上聚集庆祝节日。
words.en: If people gather somewhere, or if someone gathers people somewhere, they come together in a group.

words.tr:
n. 纽带；联系；债券；保释金；协定
v. （使）黏合；相互联结
words.ex: Family is the bond that keeps us together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭是我们团结的纽带。
words.en: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

words.ex: The two events happened simultaneously.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件同时发生了。
words.en: Happening, existing, or done at the same time.

words.tr:
n. 展示；陈列；
v. 展示；陈列；
words.ex: The store has a big display of new phones.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有一个新手机的展示。
words.en: To display something means to put it in a place where people can see it easily, or to show it to people.

words.tr:
v. 集合起来；振作；复苏
n. 集会
words.ex: The crowd rallied to support their team.
words.ex_cn: 人群聚集起来支持他们的球队。
words.en: A rally is a large public meeting that is held in order to show support for something such as a political party or a sports team. It can also mean to come together again in order to continue fighting or arguing after a defeat or a period of confusion.

words.ex: The big rock was an obstacle on the road.
words.ex_cn: 那块大石头是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.ex: The river is broad and slow.
words.ex_cn: 这条河宽阔而平缓。
words.en: Something that is broad is wide.

words.ex: His intellect helps him solve difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他的智力帮助他解决难题。
words.en: The ability to understand and think in a logical way about things.

words.ex: He works hard to earn money.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以赚取收入。
words.en: To earn means to gain something, especially money or respect, through your own efforts or work.

words.tr:
adj. 平行的；
n. 类似的事物；
words.ex: The two lines are parallel and never meet.
words.ex_cn: 这两条线是平行的，永远不会相交。
words.en: Something that is parallel to something else is similar to it in many ways, or happens at the same time as it.

words.ex: He is diligent in doing his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都很勤奋地做作业。
words.en: Someone who is diligent works hard and is careful and thorough.

words.tr:
v. 突出；强调；高光；
n. 最突出的部分；
words.ex: The teacher highlighted the key words in the text.
words.ex_cn: 老师把文中的关键词突出了。
words.en: To highlight something means to make it stand out or to emphasize it, often because it is important or interesting.

words.ex: He took an intensive English course last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他参加了一个密集的英语课程。
words.en: Intensive is used to describe something that involves a lot of effort, energy, or attention in a short period of time.

words.tr:
n. 全体演员；
v. 投掷；扔；投射；
words.ex: The cast of the play performed very well.
words.ex_cn: 这部剧的全体演员表演得非常好。
words.en: To cast something means to throw it forcefully in a particular direction.

words.ex: He greet his friend with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着向朋友问好。
words.en: To greet someone means to say hello to them or to welcome them.

words.ex: The radar shows a plane coming near.
words.ex_cn: 雷达显示一架飞机正在靠近。
words.en: A system for detecting the presence, direction, distance, and speed of aircraft, ships, and other objects, by sending out pulses of radio waves which are reflected off the object back to the source.

words.ex: He will assemble the toy for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他将为儿子组装玩具。
words.en: If people assemble or if someone assembles them, they come together in a group, usually for a particular purpose such as a meeting.

words.ex: The smoke came out of the vent.
words.ex_cn: 烟从排气口飘了出来。
words.en: A vent is a hole or opening that allows air, gas, or liquid to pass out of or into a confined space.

words.ex: The index of 2 in 2^3 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 2^3 中 2 的指数是 3。
words.en: An index is a system by which changes in the value of something and the rate at which it changes can be recorded, measured, or interpreted.

words.tr:
v. 中断；暂停；
n. 停顿下来；
words.ex: The storm halted the flight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴中断了航班。
words.en: to bring or come to a stop; a temporary or permanent stop

words.ex: The knight rode a horse and wore shiny armor.
words.ex_cn: 骑士骑着马，穿着闪亮的盔甲。
words.en: In the Middle Ages, a knight was a man of high social rank who had a duty to fight for his king. Knights are often depicted as noble warriors on horseback.

words.ex: The old estate has large gardens and a beautiful mansion.
words.ex_cn: 这个古老的庄园有大片花园和一座美丽的豪宅。
words.en: An estate is all the money and property that someone owns, especially everything that is left when they die.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.ex: He adapted to the new school quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就适应了新学校。
words.en: To make suitable to or fit for a specific use or situation.

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.tr:
v. 摔跤；扭斗；奋力对付
n. 摔跤；角力；扭斗
words.ex: He tries to wrestle the dog away from the trash.
words.ex_cn: 他试图把狗从垃圾桶旁拉开。
words.en: To engage in a physical contest, typically involving grappling and trying to throw or immobilize the opponent, or to struggle with a difficult problem or decision.

words.ex: He strives to finish his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力完成作业。
words.en: If you strive to do something or strive for something, you make a great effort to do it or get it.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: A symbol is a shape or design that is used to represent something such as an idea, a quality, or a process.

words.ex: The storm unleashed heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 风暴释放出大雨。
words.en: If you say that someone or something unleashes a powerful force, feeling, activity, or group, you mean that they suddenly start it or send it to move somewhere.

words.ex: He contends that education is the key to success.
words.ex_cn: 他主张教育是成功的关键。
words.en: If you contend with someone or contend with something, you have to deal with a difficult situation or problem. If you contend that something is true, you state or argue that it is true.

words.ex: She added a gram of salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了一克盐。
words.en: A gram is a unit of weight in the metric system equal to one thousandth of a kilogram.

words.tr:
v. 分开；分裂；
n. 划分；分歧；
words.ex: The tree split in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那棵树在风暴中裂开了。
words.en: If something splits or if you split it, it is divided into two or more parts.

words.ex: He strengthened his muscle by lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他通过举重来增强肌肉。
words.en: Muscle is the tissue in the body that can contract to produce movement or maintain the position of parts of the body.

words.ex: The soldier walks to the camp every morning.
words.ex_cn: 士兵每天早上步行去营地。
words.en: A soldier is a person who serves in an army.

words.tr:
n. 一摞；一叠；一堆；大烟囱；
v. 把…放成整齐的一摞；
words.ex: He put the books in a stack on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书堆成一摞放在桌子上。
words.en: A stack is a pile of things, usually arranged one on top of another.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.ex: The spokesman spoke clearly at the press conference.
words.ex_cn: 发言人在新闻发布会上清晰地发言。
words.en: A spokesman is a man who speaks on behalf of a group or an organization.

words.tr: n. 层次体系；等级制度；
words.ex: The company has a clear hierarchy from manager to worker.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有一个从经理到员工的明确层次体系。
words.en: A hierarchy is a system in which people or things are arranged according to their importance.

words.ex: The loud noise every night is a nuisance.
words.ex_cn: 每晚的噪音真是个讨厌的事。
words.en: A nuisance is a person, thing, or situation that is annoying or causes trouble.

words.ex: The army tried to invade the neighboring country.
words.ex_cn: 军队试图侵犯邻国。
words.en: To enter a country, town, or region by force in order to take control of it.

words.ex: He worked overtime to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他加班完成了这个项目。
words.en: Overtime refers to the time worked beyond one's regular working hours, often with additional pay.

words.ex: There is ample food for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有足够的食物。
words.en: If there is an ample amount of something, there is enough of it and usually some extra.

words.ex: The thermostat helps regulate the room temperature.
words.ex_cn: 恒温器有助于调节室温。
words.en: To regulate something means to control or manage it, especially by means of rules or laws.

words.ex: He drives an automobile to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: A vehicle that is powered by an engine and is used for carrying passengers on roads.

words.ex: Please specify the time for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 请详细说明会议的时间。
words.en: If you specify something, you give information about what is required or should happen in a certain situation.

words.ex: The painter used vivid colors to show the forest.
words.ex_cn: 画家用鲜艳的颜色来描绘森林。
words.en: If you describe memories and descriptions as vivid, you mean that they are very clear and detailed.

words.ex: He crushed the can with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手把罐子压碎了。
words.en: To crush something means to press it very hard so that its shape is destroyed or so that it breaks into pieces. It can also mean to defeat someone completely, or to make someone feel extremely upset or disappointed.

words.ex: He learned a new phrase in Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一个新的西班牙语短语。
words.en: A phrase is a short group of words that people often use as a way of saying something. The meaning of a phrase is often not obvious from the meaning of the individual words in it.

words.ex: He showed the utmost care when handling the fragile glass.
words.ex_cn: 他在处理易碎的玻璃时表现出了最大的小心。
words.en: The greatest or highest degree of something.

words.ex: This phone is superior to the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比旧的更好。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as superior, you mean that they are better than other people or things.

words.ex: It is evident that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is evident, it is easy to see, perceive, or understand.

words.tr:
v. 弥漫；
adj. 分散的；
words.ex: Smoke began to diffuse through the room.
words.ex_cn: 烟开始弥漫在整个房间里。
words.en: If something such as knowledge or information is diffused, or if it diffuses, it is made known over a wide area or to a lot of people.

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.tr:
adj. 大规模的；大量的；
n. 大量；质量；块；群；团；
words.ex: The company launched a mass production line to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 该公司启动了大规模生产线以满足需求。
words.en: A mass is a large amount of something that has no particular shape or arrangement.

words.ex: The can is made of tin.
words.ex_cn: 这个罐子是锡做的。
words.en: Tin is a soft, silvery-white metal that is often used to coat other metals to prevent them from rusting. It is also used in the production of tin cans and other containers.

words.tr: adj. 最终的；最后的；极端的；
words.ex: This is the ultimate solution to the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个问题的最终解决方案。
words.en: You use ultimate to describe the final result or aim of a long series of events.

words.ex: I perceive a change in his mood.
words.ex_cn: 我察觉到他的情绪有变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.ex: The team works in harmony.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队合作得很和谐。
words.en: Harmony is the pleasant combination of different notes of music played at the same time. It can also refer to a situation in which people are peaceful and agree with each other, or when things seem right or suitable together.

words.tr:
v. 豁免；
adj. 被免除的；
words.ex: The school exempted him from the test.
words.ex_cn: 学校免除了他的考试。
words.en: If someone or something is exempt from a particular rule, duty, or obligation, they do not have to follow it or do it.

words.tr:
v. 使目眩；使眼花；使惊叹
n. 耀眼；眩惑；灿烂
words.ex: The stars dazzle at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚的星星闪耀夺目。
words.en: If something dazzles you, it is so bright that you cannot see properly for a short time. It can also mean to greatly impress someone.

words.ex: The cat creeps slowly toward the bird.
words.ex_cn: 猫蹑手蹑脚地向鸟靠近。
words.en: To move slowly and quietly, especially in a way that does not attract attention.

words.ex: The noise will diminish after midnight.
words.ex_cn: 午夜后噪音会减少。
words.en: If something diminishes, or if something diminishes it, it becomes reduced in size, importance, or intensity.

words.ex: The government wants to eradicate poverty.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望消灭贫困。
words.en: To eradicate something means to get rid of it completely.

words.ex: Farmers grow wheat in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植小麦。
words.en: Wheat is a cereal plant that is grown in temperate countries and is the most important kind grown for food.

words.ex: Warm weather favors plant growth.
words.ex_cn: 温暖的天气有利于植物生长。
words.en: If you regard something or someone with favor, you like or support them.

words.tr:
adj. 净余的；
n. 网；
words.ex: The net profit after taxes is $500.
words.ex_cn: 缴税后的净收益是500美元。
words.en: A net is a piece of thin fabric or thread that is used to catch fish, insects, or other small animals. It can also refer to the amount of money remaining after all expenses have been deducted.

words.ex: He walked alongside the river.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着河边走。
words.en: If one thing is alongside another thing, the first thing is next to the second.

words.ex: The dog ran through the mud.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑过了泥地。
words.en: Mud is a sticky mixture of earth and water.

words.ex: The ceremony was solemn and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 仪式庄严而安静。
words.en: Solemn means very serious and not cheerful, often because something important or sad is happening or being remembered.

words.ex: He went to the dental clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去牙科诊所做检查。
words.en: Relating to the teeth or to the work of a dentist.

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.tr: n. 过错；故障；缺陷；断层；
words.ex: It was his fault that the car crashed.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞车是他的过错。
words.en: A fault is a mistake or a weakness in something or someone.

words.ex: The desert has a harsh climate.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的气候非常严酷。
words.en: If you describe something as harsh, you mean that it is extremely difficult and unpleasant to live in, do, or experience, especially because it is very cold, hot, or violent.

words.ex: His greed made him steal money from his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他的贪婪让他偷了朋友的钱。
words.en: Greed is the desire to have more of something, such as food or money, than is necessary or fair.

words.tr:
n. 腐烂；衰落；
v. 腐烂；
words.ex: The fruit began to show signs of decay.
words.ex_cn: 这水果开始出现腐烂的迹象。
words.en: To decay means to be slowly destroyed by a natural process or to become gradually worse in quality, condition, or strength.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.tr:
n. 限制；
v. 限制；
words.ex: The teacher set a limit on homework time.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业时间设定了限制。
words.en: A limit is the greatest amount, extent, or degree of something that is possible.

words.tr:
n. 情节；小块用地；
v. 绘图；
words.ex: The plot of the movie was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的情节非常精彩。
words.en: A plot is a secret plan by a group of people to do something that is illegal or wrong, especially against a person or a government. It can also refer to the main events of a play, novel, movie, or similar work, devised and presented by the writer as an interrelated sequence. Additionally, a plot can be a small piece of land that is used or intended for a specific purpose.

words.tr: n. 畅销书；畅销书作者；畅销商品
words.ex: This novel became a bestseller in just one week.
words.ex_cn: 这本小说在一周内就成了畅销书。
words.en: A book, product, or service that is very popular and sells in large quantities.

words.ex: She has an extraordinary talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 她具有非凡的音乐天赋。
words.en: Something that is extraordinary is very unusual or remarkable.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.ex: The queen's reign lasted 70 years.
words.ex_cn: 女王的统治持续了70年。
words.en: The period during which a sovereign rules; to hold royal office; to prevail

words.ex: He craves chocolate when he is stressed.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到压力时，他渴望吃巧克力。
words.en: If you crave something, or crave for it, you want to have it very much.

words.ex: He gave a concise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了简明的回答。
words.en: Something that is concise says everything that is necessary without using any unnecessary words.

words.ex: The company will hire a new manager next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司下周将雇用一位新经理。
words.en: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

words.tr:
n. 过量；过度；超过；
adj. 多余的；
words.ex: The excess of sugar in his diet caused health problems.
words.ex_cn: 他饮食中糖分过量导致了健康问题。
words.en: An excess of something is a larger amount than is needed, allowed, or usual.

words.ex: The company will compensate you for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 公司会因延误而补偿你。
words.en: If you compensate for a lack of something or for something you have done wrong, you do something to show that you are sorry or that you are trying to make things better.

words.ex: He had a setback when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，遇到了挫折。
words.en: A setback is an event that delays your progress or reverses some of the progress that you have made.

words.ex: He burst into rage when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他勃然大怒。
words.en: Rage is a feeling of intense anger that is difficult to control.

words.ex: The farmer dug a ditch to water the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农夫挖了一条沟来给田地浇水。
words.en: A ditch is a long narrow trench or furrow dug in the ground, especially for drainage or irrigation.

words.tr:
n. 半身像；胸部；搜捕
v. 打碎；搜捕
adj. 破产的；打碎的
words.ex: The museum has a marble bust of the ancient king.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一座古代国王的大理石半身像。
words.en: A bust is a sculpture of a person's head, shoulders, and chest. As a verb, to bust means to break something, to arrest someone, or to go bankrupt.

words.tr: n. 历史遗迹；纪念碑；不朽作品；
words.ex: The ancient monument attracts many tourists each year.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代历史遗迹每年吸引许多游客。
words.en: A monument is a large structure, usually made of stone, which is built to remind people of an important person or event.

words.ex: Farmers cultivate rice in the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植水稻。
words.en: To cultivate land means to prepare it and grow crops on it. To cultivate a particular quality, skill, or attitude means to try hard to develop it and make it stronger.

words.ex: The movie is a satire about politicians.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部关于政治家的讽刺作品。
words.en: A way of criticizing people or ideas in a humorous way, especially in order to make a political point, or a piece of writing that uses this style.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；承包人；
words.ex: He is an entrepreneur who started a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创办了小型咖啡店的企业家。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so.

words.tr: adj. 有（法律）责任的；有…倾向的；
words.ex: He is liable for the damage caused by his car.
words.ex_cn: 他对他的车造成的损害负有责任。
words.en: If you are liable for something such as a debt or a duty, you are legally responsible for it. If something is liable to happen, it is very likely to happen.

words.tr: adj. 温和的；文雅的；温柔的；
words.ex: The mother gave a gentle hug to her child.
words.ex_cn: 母亲给了孩子一个温和的拥抱。
words.en: Someone who is gentle is kind and calm, and does not behave in a violent or harsh way.

words.tr:
n. 撤退；退却；静居处；
v. 撤退；退却；
words.ex: The army ordered a retreat after the battle.
words.ex_cn: 战斗后，军队下令撤退。
words.en: If you retreat, you move away from something or someone, often because you are frightened or because you want to be alone. A retreat is also a quiet, isolated place that you go to in order to rest or to do things in private.

words.ex: He ate eggs and bacon for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了鸡蛋和培根。
words.en: Bacon is a type of salt-cured pork made from various cuts, typically from the pork belly or from back cuts, which are less fatty than the belly.

words.ex: The pedestrian crossed the street at the zebra crossing.
words.ex_cn: 行人在斑马线处过马路。
words.en: A pedestrian is a person who is walking in a city, town, or village, especially along a pavement or in a pedestrian area.

words.ex: He drank a bottle of soda after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后喝了一瓶苏打。
words.en: A type of drink that contains bubbles of gas and is often sweet.

words.ex: The children played on the deck of the ship.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在船的甲板上玩耍。
words.en: A deck is a floor-like surface on a ship, or a set of cards used in games. It can also mean to decorate or adorn something.

words.tr:
n. 病房；病室；选区；
v. 监护；守护；挡住；
words.ex: The patient is in ward 5.
words.ex_cn: 病人在5号病房。
words.en: A ward is a separate room in a hospital, typically one allocated to a particular type of patient, or a person, especially a child, who is under the protection or care of a legal guardian or a court.

words.ex: It was raining, nonetheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下着雨，尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Nonetheless is used to indicate that something is true or happens in spite of what has just been said.

words.ex: The ancient temple stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庙宇矗立在山上。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions.

words.ex: The children play near the fountain in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园的喷泉附近玩耍。
words.en: A fountain is a structure that squirts water into the air to create a visual or auditory effect, or a natural source of water.

words.ex: The teacher showed a bias for students who arrived early.
words.ex_cn: 老师对早到的学生有偏爱。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.ex: The accident was fatal.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是致命的。
words.en: If an action or event is fatal, it causes someone's death.

words.tr: n. 出口；发泄途径；经销店；折扣店
words.ex: The river flows out through an outlet.
words.ex_cn: 河水通过一个出口流出。
words.en: An outlet is a hole or pipe through which liquid or air can flow out, or a point in a wall where you can connect electrical equipment to the electricity supply.

words.ex: The dog jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 狗跳过了栅栏。
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. If you fence an area of land, you surround it with a fence.

words.tr: adj. 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的；
words.ex: He is a notorious thief who stole from many stores.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个声名狼藉的小偷，偷过许多商店。
words.en: Someone or something that is notorious is well known for something bad.

words.ex: We need to quantify the results of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要量化实验的结果。
words.en: If you try to quantify something, you try to calculate how much of it there is.

words.ex: He likes to ski in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山里滑雪。
words.en: A ski is one of a pair of long, flat runners attached to the feet for gliding over snow. Skiing is the activity of gliding over snow on skis.

words.ex: The scholar published a book about ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位学者出版了一本关于古代历史的书。
words.en: A scholar is a person who studies an academic subject and knows a lot about it.

words.ex: I can't find my keys here; they must be elsewhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在这儿找不到我的钥匙，它们一定在别处。
words.en: In or to some other place; not here.

words.ex: This phone is outdated and doesn't work well.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了，用起来不好。
words.en: If you describe something as outdated, you mean that you think it is old-fashioned and no longer useful or relevant to modern life.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.ex: The widow lives alone in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位寡妇独自住在一所小房子里。
words.en: A widow is a woman whose spouse has died and who has not remarried.

words.ex: He used an analogy to explain how the heart works.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个类比来解释心脏是如何工作的。
words.en: If you make or draw an analogy between two things, you show that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: The boy resembles his father.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩长得像他父亲。
words.en: If one thing or person resembles another, they are similar to each other.

words.tr: adj. 可疑的；怀疑的；拿不准的；
words.ex: The deal seemed dubious to me.
words.ex_cn: 这个交易在我看来很可疑。
words.en: If you describe something as dubious, you mean that you do not consider it to be completely honest, safe, or reliable.

words.ex: He used a pretext to leave the meeting early.
words.ex_cn: 他找了个借口提前离开了会议。
words.en: A pretext is a false reason that you give for doing something, usually something bad, in order to hide the real reason.

words.ex: He eats eggs but watches his cholesterol.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋，但注意自己的胆固醇。
words.en: Cholesterol is a substance that exists in the cells of the body and in blood, which can cause heart disease if there is too much of it.

words.ex: The weather can dictate what we wear each day.
words.ex_cn: 天气可以支配我们每天穿什么。
words.en: To dictate means to say or read something aloud for someone else to write down, or to give orders in an authoritative manner.

words.ex: His metabolism is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 他的新陈代谢非常快。
words.en: Metabolism is the set of life-sustaining chemical transformations within the cells of living organisms.

words.ex: I draw money from the bank every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周从银行提取钱。
words.en: To make a picture, pattern, or diagram by making lines and marks, especially with a pen or pencil, on paper.

words.tr: adj. 能吃苦耐劳的；耐寒的；
words.ex: He is a hardy farmer who works in the field all day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个能吃苦耐劳的农民，整天在田里干活。
words.en: Someone who is hardy is strong and able to cope with difficult conditions.

words.ex: The outward force pushed the door open.
words.ex_cn: 向外的力把门推开了。
words.en: An outward movement or position is one that is directed towards the outside or away from the centre.

words.ex: The teacher commends her for working hard.
words.ex_cn: 老师表扬她学习努力。
words.en: If you commend someone or something, you praise them formally.

words.tr:
n. 同事；（组织的）会员；家伙；同胞；
adj. 同类的；同事的；
words.ex: He works as a fellow with Dr. Smith in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验室里与史密斯博士一起工作，是他的同事。
words.en: A fellow is a man or boy. In British English, a fellow is also a member of certain academic societies.

words.tr: v. 使浸透；使湿透；使满；使饱和
words.ex: The sponge will saturate if you pour too much water.
words.ex_cn: 如果你倒太多水，海绵会吸满。
words.en: To saturate something means to make it completely wet, or to fill it completely with something so that no more can be added.

words.ex: He bought a stake in the new company.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了这家新公司的股份。
words.en: A stake is a pointed stick or post that is pushed into the ground, for example to support a young tree. It can also refer to a share or interest in a business, situation, or system.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.ex: The government announced a major reform in education.
words.ex_cn: 政府宣布了教育方面的重大改革。
words.en: If someone reforms a system, they change or improve it.

words.ex: The water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: Celsius is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees.

words.ex: He injured his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: To injure someone means to cause them physical harm, for example in an accident or an attack.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.ex: The wood surface is rough.
words.ex_cn: 木头表面很粗糙。
words.en: If a surface is rough, it is not smooth and has bumps or uneven areas.

words.ex: The rainbow is a natural phenomenon.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹是一种自然现象。
words.en: A phenomenon is something that is observed to happen or exist, especially something that is unusual or interesting.

words.ex: She bought some cloth to make a dress.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一些布来做裙子。
words.en: Cloth is fabric which is made by weaving or knitting cotton, wool, silk, or other threads. Cloth is used especially for making clothes.

words.ex: He used too much jargon in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中用了太多行话。
words.en: Special words or expressions that are used by a particular profession or group and are difficult for others to understand.

words.tr: v. 激活；使活动；使活化；
words.ex: Press the button to activate the device.
words.ex_cn: 按下按钮来激活设备。
words.en: If a device or process is activated, it starts working or becomes operational.

words.ex: The house has three storeys.
words.ex_cn: 这栋房子有三层。
words.en: A storey is a level of a building; a floor.

words.ex: The merchant sells fresh fruit every morning.
words.ex_cn: 商人每天早上卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A merchant is a person who buys and sells goods, especially one who owns a shop.

words.ex: He flipped the pancake with a spatula.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子快速翻转了煎饼。
words.en: To flip something means to turn it over quickly one or more times, or to make something do this.

words.ex: The survey asks about your gender.
words.ex_cn: 这个调查询问你的性别。
words.en: Gender is the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, not just biological ones.

words.ex: The baby is crawling on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在地板上爬。
words.en: To move slowly on hands and knees or by dragging the body close to the ground.

words.ex: He is my business partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的商业合伙人。
words.en: A partner is someone who you are involved with in a particular activity, especially in business or in a personal relationship.

words.tr:
v. 称赞；恭维
n. 称赞；恭维
words.ex: He gave her a compliment on her dress.
words.ex_cn: 他夸了她的裙子。
words.en: A compliment is a polite expression of praise or admiration.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.ex: A dog is a mammal.
words.ex_cn: 狗是一种哺乳动物。
words.en: A mammal is a type of animal that feeds its young with milk produced by the mother's body. Mammals are warm-blooded and usually have hair or fur.

words.ex: He tries to restrain his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他努力克制自己的愤怒。
words.en: If you restrain someone, you stop them from doing what they intended or wanted to do, usually by using your physical strength.

words.tr:
n. 旋转；
v. 旋转；
words.ex: The spin of the top made it stay upright.
words.ex_cn: 陀螺的旋转让它保持直立。
words.en: If something spins or if you spin it, it turns quickly around a central point.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.tr: n. 一阵强劲的气流；爆炸；
words.ex: A blast of cold wind hit the window.
words.ex_cn: 一阵冷风击中了窗户。
words.en: A blast is a sudden loud noise or a strong gust of wind. It can also refer to an explosion or the act of blowing something up. As a verb, it means to explode or to criticize severely.

words.ex: The earthquake devastated the small town.
words.ex_cn: 地震摧毁了这个小镇。
words.en: To devastate means to destroy or ruin something completely, or to cause someone to feel extreme sadness or shock.

words.ex: The company is bankrupt after losing all its money.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司失去所有钱后破产了。
words.en: If a person or a company is bankrupt, they have been declared by a court of law to be unable to pay their debts.

words.ex: He cannot breathe when he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得快时无法呼吸。
words.en: To breathe means to take air into your lungs and then expel it, a process necessary for life.

words.tr:
n. 攻击；袭击；
v. 攻击；袭击；
words.ex: The attack happened at night.
words.ex_cn: 这次攻击发生在夜晚。
words.en: To attack means to try to hurt or defeat someone or something by using force or violence.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.ex: Good teachers motivate students to learn.
words.ex_cn: 好老师激励学生学习。
words.en: To motivate someone means to provide them with a reason for doing something, especially something that requires effort.

words.ex: He carved the meat with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀切开了肉。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.tr: adv. 更确切地说；宁可；相当；
words.ex: I don't like coffee; rather, I prefer tea.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢咖啡；更确切地说，我更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use rather to indicate that something is true to a fairly great extent, especially when you are talking about something unpleasant or undesirable.

words.ex: The cat occupies the sofa all day.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫整天占据着沙发。
words.en: If people or things occupy a place, they are in it or fill it.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.ex: He is impatient when he waits for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他等公交车时很不耐烦。
words.en: If you are impatient, you are easily annoyed by delays or by people making mistakes.

words.ex: He does yoga every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做瑜伽。
words.en: Yoga is a Hindu spiritual and ascetic discipline, a part of which, including breath control, simple meditation, and the adoption of specific bodily postures, is widely practiced for health and relaxation.

words.ex: She wore a dress for the occasion.
words.ex_cn: 她为了这个特殊场合穿了一条裙子。
words.en: An occasion is a particular time when something happens, or a special event.

words.tr: n. 祖父；祖母；外祖父；外祖母
words.ex: My grandparent lives in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖父住在一个小村庄里。
words.en: A grandparent is the parent of your father or mother.

words.ex: After the break, we will proceed with the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 休息后，我们将继续开会。
words.en: If you proceed to do something, you continue to do it or start to do it after doing something else first.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.ex: His condition improved after the treatment.
words.ex_cn: 他的状况在接受治疗后好转了。
words.en: A condition is a state of affairs that must exist or be brought about before something else can happen or be done.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.ex: The foundation gives money to poor students.
words.ex_cn: 这个基金会向贫困学生提供资金。
words.en: The foundation of something such as a belief or way of life is the things on which it is based.

words.ex: The library keeps old newspapers in an archive.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆把旧报纸保存在档案馆里。
words.en: A collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people.

words.ex: He will fix the broken chair tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会修理那把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: To fix something means to repair it, to make it firm or stable, or to arrange or decide it.

words.ex: I admire my teacher for her patience.
words.ex_cn: 我钦佩我的老师有耐心。
words.en: If you admire someone or something, you like and respect them very much.

words.ex: The owl sleeps in the tree during the day.
words.ex_cn: 猫头鹰白天在树上睡觉。
words.en: An owl is a bird with a flat face, large eyes, and a small sharp beak. Most owls hunt at night.

words.tr:
n. 最小值；
adj. 最小量的；
words.ex: The minimum of the function is 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个函数的最小值是5。
words.en: The minimum is the smallest or least amount possible or allowed.

words.ex: He stopped halfway to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他在半路停下来休息。
words.en: At or to a point midway between two others.

words.ex: He uses the web to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用网络来查找信息。
words.en: A web is a thin net made from sticky threads that a spider uses to catch insects.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: The boss appointed Tom as the new manager.
words.ex_cn: 老板任命汤姆为新经理。
words.en: If you appoint someone to a job or official position, you formally choose them for it.

words.ex: His humor makes everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他的幽默让大家都笑了。
words.en: The quality of being amusing or comic, especially as expressed in literature or speech.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.ex: They will nominate her for the award.
words.ex_cn: 他们将提名她获得这个奖项。
words.en: If someone is nominated for a job or position, their name is formally suggested as a candidate for it.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.ex: She blends flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To mix substances together so that they combine into a single substance.

words.ex: Drugs can relieve pain.
words.ex_cn: 药物可以减轻疼痛。
words.en: To relieve someone or something means to make a problem, pain, or unpleasant feeling less severe or to take it away completely.

words.ex: He often criticizes his brother for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他经常批评他弟弟迟到。
words.en: If you criticize someone or something, you express your disapproval of them by saying what you think is wrong with them.

words.ex: The little cabin is cozy and warm.
words.ex_cn: 这座小木屋舒适又温暖。
words.en: A place that is cozy is comfortable and warm.

words.tr: adj. 最新的；最近的；新式的
words.ex: He keeps his knowledge up-to-date by reading news every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天读新闻来保持知识的更新。
words.en: Someone or something that is up-to-date has the most recent information or uses the newest methods or equipment.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.ex: His mindset helps him stay positive during hard times.
words.ex_cn: 他的心态让他在困难时期保持积极。
words.en: A mindset is a set of attitudes or fixed ideas that someone has and that are often difficult to change.

words.ex: You must comply with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守规则。
words.en: To act in accordance with a wish or command.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.ex: He overlooked the mistake in the report.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了报告中的错误。
words.en: If you overlook a fact or problem, you do not notice it, or do not realize how important it is.

words.tr: adj. 头晕目眩的；头昏眼花的；
words.ex: He felt dizzy after spinning around quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速转圈后感到头晕目眩。
words.en: If you feel dizzy, you feel that you are losing your balance and are about to fall.

words.ex: They reside in a small house near the park.
